title: Low blood sugar (Earth reference, no space data)

steps.text: Suspect low blood sugar in a crewmember with diabetes or chronic malnutrition who suddenly responds less or behaves differently.

source.guideline: Djärv T, Rogers J, Semeraro F, et al. European Resuscitation Council Guidelines 2025 First Aid. Resuscitation. 2025;215:110752. doi:10.1016/j.resuscitation.2025.110752 (Earth reference, no space data)
source.section: Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar value)

steps.text: Give sugar by mouth only if the crewmember is awake and able to swallow. Amount: per flight surgeon / onboard medical checklist.

source.guideline: Djärv T, Rogers J, Semeraro F, et al. European Resuscitation Council Guidelines 2025 First Aid. Resuscitation. 2025;215:110752. doi:10.1016/j.resuscitation.2025.110752 (Earth reference, no space data)
source.section: Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar value)

steps.text: If they do not respond, give nothing by mouth because of the risk of aspiration, and contact ground.

source.guideline: Djärv T, Rogers J, Semeraro F, et al. European Resuscitation Council Guidelines 2025 First Aid. Resuscitation. 2025;215:110752. doi:10.1016/j.resuscitation.2025.110752 (Earth reference, no space data)
source.section: Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar value), unresponsive persons

steps.text: Once they have recovered, encourage them to eat a light snack.

source.guideline: Djärv T, Rogers J, Semeraro F, et al. European Resuscitation Council Guidelines 2025 First Aid. Resuscitation. 2025;215:110752. doi:10.1016/j.resuscitation.2025.110752 (Earth reference, no space data)
